name: condorcet-jury
title: Condorcet jury theorem: probability the majority of readings is correct

reference.cite: Condorcet 1785, Essai sur l'application de l'analyse a la probabilite des decisions rendues a la pluralite des voix

assumptions.text: Votes are independent given the truth, except through declared clusters, which are collapsed to one juror (mean competence, majority vote).
A juror's competence is its link reliability (llr x gives 1 - e^-x); jurors at or below 0.5 are dropped and reported.
With an even jury a tie is broken by a fair coin.
majority_correct is the reliability of the majority procedure, not P(claim); read it beside majority.

clusters.description: collapse each correlated cluster to one juror, or ignore correlation (reported as raw anyway).
